places-mas-d-en-salvador-abric-iv-penon-.story: From Albocàsser it runs 355 km to Albocàsser; allow about 6 h 07 of riding. The stops in between: Covatina del Tossalet del mas de !a Rambla, Cova de Gargán, La Joquera and Peñón de Santo Espíritu. The highest point is about 1,300 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
